Andy Burnham has made ending rough sleeping his first policy pledge as PM, backed by £340m, despite failing to meet similar targets as Greater Manchester mayor.

The Poison:
Repeating a failed promise without acknowledging the previous shortfall risks further eroding public trust in policy efficacy.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is in the HOW (logical causal chain). The plan lacks the necessary structural changes to succeed where the previous attempt failed.

Social Physics Analysis:
This is a classic case of using a moral pretext to mask a lack of a viable solution. By recycling a failed promise, the actor maintains the appearance of action while avoiding the hard work of systemic reform.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Destruction. The failure to learn from history creates a negative feedback loop.

The Unavoidable Truth: Rough sleeping has increased under his previous leadership.

The Unavoidable Lie: This new pledge is fundamentally different from the one that failed.
